summary: Close-up of the host answering 'Yes' with a sudden bright grin, bluffing.
framing: Close-up, eye level, static: host's head and collar, centre frame. Behind him plain blue wall; at the left edge a vertical glowing red-orange strip (light from the burning kitchen through the door gap); at the upper right the corner of a green-framed picture.
props: green-framed picture, corner visible at upper right, static

beats.action: head 3/4 left, level; eyelids half lowered, pupils left (looking at the guest off-screen left); mouth a flat, slightly down-turned line; holds still
red-orange glow strip down the left edge of frame, steady (no flicker measurable) for the whole shot
head lifts and tips back, moving up-right in frame; eyelids start to open, mouth opens into the start of a smile
eyes snap fully open, round, pupils centred and staring left; brows up; open smiling mouth as he says the word
head reaches its highest point (hair touches the top of frame) and stays there
mouth closes to a wide fixed toothy grin, teeth together; eyes stay wide and unblinking; holds to the cut

notes: No blink. Camera static confirmed (left-edge strip moves < 0.5 px). Dialogue: L54 'Yes' is timed at 3522-3531 in script.json; the mouth opens at 3518-3519 and is already closed into the grin at 3528, so the visible mouth shape runs about 3 frames ahead of the audio alignment.
